description: This Kotlin source file defines HomeViewModel, a ViewModel class for managing UI state and data fetching for the home screen in an Android application. It interacts with ContentRepository to load 'Continue Watching' items and TV channels, and manages their states via LiveData. It also includes the UiState sealed class representing different UI load states.

classes.name: HomeViewModel
classes.description: ViewModel for the home screen, manages loading 'Continue Watching' items and TV channels, and exposes their states via LiveData.

classes.name: UiState
classes.description: Sealed class representing the UI loading state, including Loading, Success, and Error states.

methods.name: loadContinueWatching
methods.description: Fetches 'Continue Watching' items for a user, updating the LiveData state accordingly.

methods.name: loadTvChannels
methods.description: Fetches TV channels data, updating the LiveData state accordingly.

methods.name: retryContinueWatching
methods.description: Retries loading 'Continue Watching' items, defaulting to a preset userId.
